lines.text: This gameplay is enough to put me to sleep.
Ugh! Another round! That's no fair!
How come you die so much, Noob?

I am an untraceable hacker.
Tonight, our objective is to obtain the enemy's source code.

Don't tell me you're still not strong enough?
Don't worry, let the pro help you out.

*Yawn* I'm sleepy.
Be my pillow, will you?

Helloooo, the game won't play itself!
Input a command already.
Does your mind wander whenever you're in front of a Nikke?
The radio tower is hands down the best place to play online games!
I wonder where I can get the strongest connection...
Allow me to introduce myself. Nobody can top me when it comes to hacking, and I'm at the top of the leaderboards as well.
Oh my gosh, my power is over 9000!
If you think this will make me happy, well... You're right!
I hate offline meet-ups, but if it's you, Noob, I suppose I can make an exception.

Bond level up.
Congrats, you've unlocked the ability to caress my hair.
The top-ranked player has ice in her veins but is far from icy with you.
All right noobs, can you "hack" it?
Hacking the enemy system - hacking completed.

Is it Rudolph, or is it Bambi?
Take a guess, Noob.
Wait just a moment. We can't miss the Christmas event.
I made these clothes myself. Just kidding, I bought them.

What are you doing for Christmas?
If you don't have anything planned, let's play a game.

Actually, I'm not wearing anything under this.
I wonder if that will get some kind of reaction...
It looks like something you could ride, but not me.
Fine, ignore me all you want. I'm busy with the Christmas event anyway.
Even my sides are cold in the winter. Brrr...
You could at least put up a tree...
I knew I wouldn't be able to fool you so easily. How disappointing...
Tada. Rudolph's bite has turned this poor girl into a were-Rudolph.
It's common to have a lot of EXP events during Christmas.
Are there any other prizes for leveling up?
I always feel different on special days like this.
Wow, thanks Noob! It's fantastic. I've been dying to say this line forever.
For you Noob, you can lean on me.
There's a Bond increase event for Christmas.
You will belong to Exia. Proceed?
Extreme cold mode Exia, ready for launch.
I want to try walking on all fours, but I guess that's a bit much.
You're getting a nightmare for Christmas.
It's annoying to reload in these gloves...
This Rudolph isn't just for show!

favorite.description: Back in those days, everything revolved around this little console. We'd gear up as warriors, slay monsters, and start off on new adventures. Next thing you know, we're inseparable companions.
